methodology: Every listed champion has editorial solo-queue guidance, counterplay and a cooldown/resource to track. Role plans and selected interactions explain opportunities, not measured counters. Scores reflect shown team composition, not win probabilities. PC kit references and game-specific patch summaries are separate from strategic inference. Named matchup coverage remains limited; unlisted matchups are unknown, not neutral. Legacy 7.1g rules are no longer used.

pc.label: League PC
pc.summary: Caitlyn and Jinx lose scaling power; Miss Fortune receives compensation buffs. Ranged Hubris and Gluttonous Greaves are nerfed. Includes the October 22 Varus hotfix. Summoner’s Rift only.

changes.Caitlyn: Less late-game Headshot damage; higher Q base damage at later ranks.
changes.Jinx: Lower starting health and attack damage growth.
changes.Miss Fortune: More E damage and stronger ultimate critical damage.
changes.Varus: October 22: Q multi-target bug fixed; passive scaling and minimum Q damage increased.
changes.Darius: Shorter Q cooldown at maximum rank.
changes.Lee Sin: Longer W cooldown and lower ultimate damage.
changes.Locke: Mana and sustain adjustments alongside stronger E scaling.
changes.Nidalee: Lower cougar W damage and E attack speed.
changes.Orianna: Higher Q and W ability power ratios.

wr.label: Wild Rift
wr.summary: Jhin gets earlier damage; Yunara and Senna lose damage. Cheaper Statikk Shiv and Yun Tal change purchase timings. Tank supports gain a cheaper, healthier Locket. Changes alone do not establish the best picks.

changes.Jhin: Higher standard critical damage; missing-health damage caps at level 10 instead of 15.
changes.Yunara: Lower first-ability damage; longer ultimate cooldown at later ranks.
changes.Senna: Lower critical damage, attack damage per soul and first-ability base damage.
changes.Volibear: More second-ability attack damage scaling and empowered healing.
changes.Tryndamere: Consistent critical chance per Fury and higher Spinning Slash damage.
changes.Hwei: Reduced passive damage, shielding and some spell damage/range.
changes.Nocturne: Lower health growth, reduced early first-ability damage and longer ultimate cooldown.
changes.Yasuo: Higher critical damage and stronger scaling shield.

draftChecklist: Choose the game first: champion availability, items, runes and balance differ.
Judge the full bot duo: range, engage, sustain, wave control and jungle pressure.
Plan your first purchase and power spike; avoid copying timings between games.
Check team damage mix, frontline and peel before locking a carry.
Prefer a practiced champion when matchup evidence is limited.
nextDataPriorities: Matchup samples with game, patch, rank, region, role, games played and win rate.
Reviewed duo synergies, first-item spikes and lane trading plans.
Per-role confidence and review dates; separate blind-pick safety from counterpick value.
